title: Report types: what the person asked for decides how the research is planned, read, stopped and written
note: Read by code (src/report_types.py). Chosen by the person in the app; when they do not choose, the question's wording decides (route_when, tried in order), else a brief. Every type has a deadline (time spent working; waiting for approval or paused does not count): each step watches it and the run moves on to writing while there is still time to write. Decided with the user on 2026-11-11: a deep report must finish within 10 minutes on this laptop. Measured here: qwen3:8b reads about 2,300 tokens a second and writes about 43, so reading is planned generously and writing sparingly.

types.label: Brief
types.about: A short answer to the question: stops as soon as a Tier 1 or Tier 2 source states each fact.

types.label: General report
types.about: A report of several sections on the question: each section is backed by more than one independent source.

angles: the direct answer to the question
the key events and their dates
who is involved: partners, customers, competitors
what the company says comes next, and what is not known

types.label: Deep research report
types.about: A long report from many documents read in depth: the company's own documents, independent reporting, figures, risks and open questions.

angles: the direct answer to the question
what the company itself says: its filings, releases and statements
the key events and their dates
the figures: amounts, scale, growth, by period
who is involved: partners, customers, competitors
what comes next: stated plans and outlook

types.label: White paper
types.about: An argued paper: the problem, what the evidence shows, the options, a recommendation and its risks.

angles: the problem and who bears it
what the evidence shows, with figures and dates
how the main players are responding
what would settle the open questions

route_note: Wording that asks for a report as a document ('write a report on', 'a deep dive into'), never the verb ('what did Acme report'): a real question was planned as a general report because it said 'report'.
section_words_note: Words per section, written one call each: about 400 tokens, 10 s here; eight sections and a summary fit the writing reserve.
